'''SalaciousCrumb We'll Handle This SalaciousCrumbStyle''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[SalaciousCrumb]]
* '''Published:''' 16 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 WHT SalaciousCrumb LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

lightsaber combat overkill

The published list has 70 cards.

== Strategy ==

get out council chamber, yoda and luke(both to naboo), kill dark jedis ;)

use falcon, lando and leia to surprise oponnent at an unsaved location -> battle damage
also use leia to cancel force drain

use obi and qui as a backup

numbers beside are those cards' destiny numbers
